single_algorithmic_change: Replace the fixed 1e-8 observation normalization floor with per-record two-snapshot RMS normalization; exact zero observations remain zero.
motivation: Registered onset snapshots have approximately 1e-13 RMS, so the old fixed floor suppressed instance-specific observation channels by about five orders of magnitude.
success_conditions: training completes without nonfinite loss or out-of-memory failure
best.pt binds the registered parent and training groups
promotion_rule: Do not access validation. Evaluate on a new train-split gate excluding the r26 and r29 gate groups.
